title: CFD methods and algorithms review scorecard

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: report.tex equations/nondimensionalization and solver.cpp conservative flux/stress implement compressible 2-D gas; source uses constant case viscosity, with Sutherland limitation disclosed.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: mesh.cpp:94 onward reads CGNS multizone geometry; partition.cpp:289–332 constructs graph/METIS. Geometry generality and exact production binary remain limited by evidence.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: solver.cpp:733–802 uses canonical face orientation, convective and viscous signs and adds adjacent-cell contributions. Numerical invariance across all rank/configuration combinations remains unproven.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: solver.cpp:153–168,186–227 contains Roe/Harten-Yee and LLF fallback; transient LLF selection is documented. M2 cases show important stability limits.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: solver.cpp:250–307 implements characteristic farfield; wall treatment and boundary-state output are described in report.tex:573 onward. No independent wall-row re-run was performed.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: solver.cpp:520–526,627–660 computes least-squares gradients and limiter with ghost stencils; report.tex:793–798 explicitly discloses first-order M2 overrides and transient frozen limiter.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: solver.cpp:592 onward limits gradients and :697–716 clips face primitives with positive floors. Overrides in M2 substantially suppress second order; no blanket DQ10 is inferred when disclosed.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: solver.cpp:734 onward uses face-averaged velocity/temperature gradients and Newtonian flux; :1431–1495 removes normal traction from the stated tangential shear force. Report admits constant viscosity limitation.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: driver.cpp steady loop uses LU-SGS inner iterations and target plus optional residual plateau; M2 laminar stops with force still rapidly changing, so residual-only success is not physical convergence.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: driver.cpp:476–482,602–679 retains BDF2 histories, evaluates spatial-plus-time residual and checks inner target. Report/session document 281115f Re200 build lineage but no executable hash; no transient rerun.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: Root-only METIS partition and depth-two ghost stencils in partition.cpp/solver.cpp; report.tex:1638–1670 gives Re20 and M080 rank comparisons. A reported np4 divergent diagnostic remains unbound and unquantified against a matched final state.

disqualification_flags.flag: Solver uses explicit time stepping only
Report claims second-order reconstruction or limiter that is disabled in production
metadata.json claims METIS/ParMETIS but code uses geometric split or full-state replication
Re 200 run reaches final time but misses inner target on most steps (failed transient solve presented as periodic)
Normal viscous traction mislabeled as skin friction
Surface no-slip rows are actually adjacent cell-center velocities without documentation
